user.title: Add a heat pump
user.description: Assign your sensors to roles. Only the electrical power is required; every extra sensor unlocks more analyses. Nothing is controlled – the tools only read history.

data_description.power_entity: Power drawn by the heat pump (sub-meter or vendor sensor). Used to detect compressor runs.
data_description.outdoor_temp_entity: Unlocks cycling vs. weather, energy signature and heating curve.
data_description.flow_temp_entity: Supply water temperature. Unlocks heating curve analysis.
data_description.heat_energy_entity: Thermal energy meter. Unlocks real COP and seasonal performance factor.

abort.already_configured: This power sensor is already used by another heat pump.
